description: T1 item 1 (Design sources), DIGITAL partition of gf180-sar-adc: the sar_ctrl RTL, the generator of its rung-1 behavioural netlist, and the netlists derived from them, each with the command that fails when it is stale. Issue #560. See signoff/README.md for what is and is not covered.

derived.generator: python3 design/sar-logic/flow/synth_sar_ctrl.py --library mcu7t5v0 (klt synthesize). The check proves the committed netlist formally equivalent to design/sar-logic/rtl/sar_ctrl.v; it does NOT re-synthesize, because byte output depends on the exact Yosys build (sim/tests/test_sar_ctrl_gate_netlist.py).
python3 design/sar-logic/flow/synth_sar_ctrl.py --library mcu9t5v0 (klt synthesize); formal equivalence to the RTL only, as for the 7-track netlist
